messages:
liam: spotting noisy-neighbor patterns in eu-central fractional slices this morning. neighbor latency up ~3x when a tiny set of tenants do sustained KV+egress. thinking: soft egress shield per-slice + automatic routing fallback.

nina: can you share the detection query and an example tenant id?

liam: prom example + tenant: tenant-harbor
```
sum(rate(kv_outbound_bytes{region=\"eu-central\"}[2m])) by (tenant)
```

omar: deploy-bot: alert eu-central_slice_egress_tail firing -> grouped by slice. deploy-bot:alert_id=euc-eg-321

deploy-bot: Alert eu-central_slice_egress_tail started at 2024-10-02T06:10:11Z severity=warning

sue: short-term flow: 1) soft-shield (allow small burst) 2) eviction hint to KV layer 3) eBPF NIC shape on pod 4) reroute sustained overflow to same-region hosted. Prefer same-region to avoid cross-region transfer costs.

nina: detection heuristic to reduce noise: 
```
WHEN kv_rate(tenant) > 120MB/2m AND gpu_ctx_switch_p95 > 0.4 AND nvlink_errors > 0 FOR 90s
```

omar: eBPF prototype exists: egress_shield v0.4 config: 
```
program: egress_shield v0.4
flags: burst_sec=20, rate_mbps=100, fallback=hosted-eu-central
metrics: tenant_reroute_cnt, rerouted_tokens_est
```

liam: cost quick calc: tenant-harbor ~1.0M bytes in 8m -> ~38k tokens -> ~$0.10 if rerouted to hosted eu-central. But avoiding 60s of GPU stall across neighbors saves more infra cost.

sue: ops playbook: canary 5% of fractional slices for 48h, notify owner on first reroute, auto-ticket on >4 reroutes/hr, revert on false-positive within 10m. Add billing tag billing:egress_fallback=true.

nina: add metric slice_shield_seconds to measure hold-time. Also ensure routing table prefers local hosted zone: 
```
route: eu-central.multipool -> prefer eu-central.hosted -> fallback eu-west.hosted
policy: soft-shield -> 30s burst then reroute
```

omar: I'll push eBPF PR to staging tonight. deploy-bot: schedule egress_shield v0.4 to staging at 4201300000 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled egress_shield v0.4 to staging at 4201300000

liam: thanks. final asks: expose tenant_reroute_cnt and rerouted_tokens_est to Optimize for 72h evaluation before wider rollout.

sue: agreed. starting canary after staging deploy + 48h of metrics. :thumbsup:
